segments.name: Sunergy
segments.description: Designs, procures, installs and services residential solar photovoltaic systems and related roofing services for homeowners.
segments.evidence: Following the acquisition of Heliogen on August 8, 2025, the Company reassessed its segment structure and determined that it operates in two operating and reportable segments: (1) Sunergy, which includes the design, procurement, installation, and servicing of residential solar photovoltaic systems and related roofing services; and (2) Heliogen, which includes concentrated solar power and long-duration energy generation and storage technology solutions for commercial and industrial applications.

segments.name: Heliogen
products: long-duration energy generation and storage technology solutions
segments.description: Supplies concentrated solar power and long-duration energy generation and storage technology solutions for commercial and industrial applications.
segments.evidence: Heliogen, which includes concentrated solar power and long-duration energy generation and storage technology solutions for commercial and industrial applications.

revenueModel.text: Homeowners pay us for solar systems, and many finance the purchase through third-party financing companies that remit payment upon installation.
revenueModel.evidence: Many customers finance the purchase and installation of solar systems through third-party financing companies.

changes.text: In 2025 the company acquired Heliogen and moved from a single reportable segment to two reportable segments, Sunergy and Heliogen.
changes.evidence: Prior to the acquisition of Heliogen, the Company operated as a single operating and reportable segment consisting of its solar installation and related services operations.
